text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—Even though I was determined to win no 
matter what, I couldn't run a good race. 
It's so, sooo frustrating...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But none of the fans were sad. ...Could 
it be that (eraser and water drop marks) ↑ 
Sorry! The sweat smudged it!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The fault's definitely on me for not 
showing them a truly cool run. I've gotta 
show them an even more amazing race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My next goal is one more race before the 
Shuka Sho: the Queen Stakes... Please look 
forward to it!"
